issues.explanation: Here 中山 is part of the historical title 中山靖王, not Zhongshan city.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: Prince of Zhongshan; keep the title together with 靖王 if desired.

issues.explanation: In 家贫, 家 means household/family, not a character used in unrelated compounds.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: household/family.

issues.explanation: In 织席, 席 means mat or woven mat, not the surname Xi.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: mat.

issues.explanation: Here 尺 is the traditional unit of length, not a gongche notation character.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: chi, a traditional unit of length.

issues.explanation: 曾 means once/formerly in 曾从郑玄、卢植求学, not the surname Zeng.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: once; formerly.

issues.explanation: Here 从 means to study under or follow, not merely a variant-form dictionary entry.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: study under; follow.

issues.explanation: 看榜 means to look at or read the posted examination list, not to look after.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: look at; read.

issues.explanation: In 听见后, 后 is the temporal word meaning afterward, not a surname.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: afterward; after that.

issues.explanation: 共举大事 means undertake or launch a major undertaking together; the current variant-only gloss is unusable.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: undertake; launch.

issues.explanation: 推车 is a natural verb-object word in this context, meaning to push a cart; splitting it also leaves 车 with a false particle annotation.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 推车 as one word, meaning push a cart.

issues.explanation: 车 is a noun meaning cart/vehicle here, not a particle or surname.
issues.suggested_fix: Type word; meaning cart.

issues.explanation: 投军 is a dictionary word meaning join the army; splitting it hides that useful lexical item.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 投军 as one word, meaning join the army.

issues.explanation: This occurrence is the personal name Guan Yu and should not be split into unrelated common-word entries.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 关羽 as one name: Guān Yǔ, Guan Yu.

issues.explanation: In this literary scene, 桃园 is the Peach Garden, not Taoyuan City or County in Taiwan.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: Peach Garden.

issues.explanation: 祭天 is a natural ritual expression meaning offer sacrifice to Heaven; splitting it hides the relevant word.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 祭天 as one word, meaning offer sacrifice to Heaven.

issues.explanation: 同心 is an ordinary phrase meaning of one mind/in unity here, not a place name.
issues.suggested_fix: Type word; meaning of one mind; united.

issues.explanation: 安民 is a natural verb-object phrase meaning bring peace to the people; the current character-level entries obscure the phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 安民 as one word or phrase, meaning bring peace to the people.

issues.explanation: This is the personal name Liu Yan, but it is incorrectly annotated as a word containing the following phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 刘焉 as a name: Liú Yān, Liu Yan.

issues.explanation: 麾下 means under someone's command or banner, not troops themselves.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: under one's command; under one's banner.

issues.explanation: This occurrence is the personal name Guan Yu and should be kept together.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 关羽 as one name: Guān Yǔ, Guan Yu.

issues.explanation: This occurrence is the personal name Guan Yu and should be kept together.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 关羽 as one name: Guān Yǔ, Guan Yu.

issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 关羽 as one name: Guān Yǔ, Guan Yu.

issues.explanation: This occurrence is the personal name Guan Yu and should be kept together.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 关羽 as one name: Guān Yǔ, Guan Yu.

issues.explanation: In 两翼, 翼 means wing; it is not the surname Yi.
issues.suggested_fix: Type word; meaning wing.

issues.explanation: 解了青州之围 means relieve or lift the siege, not the surname Xie.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: relieve; lift.

issues.explanation: Here 围 means siege, not the surname Wei.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: siege.

issues.explanation: 往 is a verb or directional preposition meaning go to/toward here, not a grammatical particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Type word; meaning go to; head toward.

issues.explanation: 令他率本部 means order him to lead; the current unrelated compound gloss gives no usable meaning.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: order; command.

issues.explanation: 本部 means one's own unit or contingent here, not headquarters.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: one's own unit; own contingent.

issues.explanation: Here 给 means give or provide him with troops, not merely the preposition gloss to.
issues.suggested_fix: Meaning: give; provide.

issues.explanation: The sentence means 趁大风，火攻长社: take advantage of the strong wind and attack with fire. 风火 is not the phrase intended here and hides 火攻.
issues.suggested_fix: Split as 风 and 火攻; gloss 火攻 as attack with fire.

issues.explanation: 长社 is a historical place name and should be kept together rather than split into unrelated entries.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 长社 as one place name: Chángshè, Changshe.
